description: This file defines the Store class within the Opencart admin controller event namespace. It includes methods for handling store-related actions—adding, editing, and deleting stores—by scheduling tasks via the setting/task model.

classes.name: Store
classes.description: Controller class for handling store events in the admin panel, facilitating task scheduling for store management actions.

methods.name: addStore
methods.description: Schedules a task to generate the store list after adding a store.

methods.name: editStore
methods.description: Schedules a task to generate the store list after editing a store.

methods.name: deleteStore
methods.description: Schedules a task to generate the store list after deleting a store.
